formula: If the parent retains an independent local affine branch, define C_MTS^lambda_{mu nu} := Gamma_MTS^lambda_{mu nu} - {lambda}_{mu nu}[g_obs].
T_MTS^lambda_{mu nu} = 2 C_MTS^lambda_{[mu nu]} because LC[g_obs] has zero torsion.
With Q_rho mu nu := -nabla^Gamma_rho g_mu nu, Q_MTS,rho mu nu = C_MTS^sigma_{rho mu} g_sigma nu + C_MTS^sigma_{rho nu} g_mu sigma under this sign convention.
A_MTS^mu := (1/6) epsilon^{alpha beta gamma mu} T_MTS,alpha beta gamma = (1/3) epsilon^{alpha beta gamma mu} C_MTS,alpha[beta gamma].
If A_MTS is computed in m^-1, the corresponding natural energy scale is A_GeV = 1.973269804e-16 * A_m^-1 before convention factors xi_A and C_basis.
units_or_use: lets a future runner compare against GeV torsion-component bounds
